notes: Calendar page: Categories is now Colour coding – simpler, with clear headings, and a box at the top saying how many of the 10 colours you’re using (in red, and Save switched off, if it’s more than 10)
General categories and family groups: one row each – name, colour (as a line, the colour is a bar along the bottom of its square), Line?, and Show? – Show, Group in Other or Hide
People in the family: each person’s colour, and Display – individually, in Family, in one of your groups, or hidden. No more dragging names into groups
Other can be shown or hidden. Someone in a group that’s put in Other now shows as Other, not as Family
